summary: Two-week window (the 10/2 run died before publishing). Week one was busy and cooperative; week two went quiet, and she paid the invoice without a single question. Week one (9/25 to 10/2): she broke her 9/22 silence herself ('hey any update ?? it’s been a couple days now on this 🙏🏼🙏🏼'), finished ALTR's new intake form, and set out her own recovery plan: reactivate @barbarasilvanew, change its email, and hand the login to Mayson's VA team. Derrek closed the login-safety blocker ('We have this, login, Barbara. Don't worry'). Week two (10/2 to 10/9): the leak report landed a second week running (Melissa, 10/2). Melissa also ran a new repost-network push, a reel on 23 accounts, and Barbara loved it ('Amazing 😻'). Vivek gave his first concrete explanation of the integrity bans on 10/3 ('Using same phone / Same phone number / Email', 'Even using wifi'). She disputes part of it ('i wasn’t using same phone or number but maybe wifi'). What did not move: her 9/14 retention message ('i really want to continue working together, i just need to see some changes because where the numbers are right now isn’t sustainable for me.') is now 25 days unanswered. The main account @thebrazilianfitbarbie has been banned 22 days with no date; the only mention all window was Vivek's 'Maybe its connected with fitbarbie'. Mayson's 'On it!' on the @barbarasilvanew email change (10/1) was never confirmed: nothing says the email was changed, the VA team logged in, or posting restarted. On 10/5 she put forward her own plan for the integrity-banned @itsbarbxoxo and asked whether to appeal Threads. Vivek's reply was 'I will check in lookup' (10/6), and nothing since. Invoice #5 (Sep 15–30, a fortnight with the main banned throughout) went out 10/1 with the pause-of-work clause for the fourth time. Stephski nudged on day 1 and chased on day 6 ('tomorrow is the deadline'). She paid on 10/7 ('Sent :)') with no question about the figure. She also mentioned her OF payouts had been switched to manual without her knowing. CHURN WATCH: three of ALTR's pre-exit signals are present: (1) the revenue/results question was answered with a call offer, never in writing (25 days); (2) long-promised deliverables have no written proof (main recovery, barbarasilva.vip 46d, Michelle's backup @ 69d, OFTV 4th video 34d); (3) a clean, question-free payment on an invoice for a period with nothing to show. Her asks also fell from 6 in week one to 2 in week two. Her last substantive message was 10/5 19:41, and the chat had no messages from 10/7 19:51 to window close. Not present: client silence of 30+ days, and billing is not the majority of ALTR traffic (6 of 52 messages).

Positives are real: the leak report held two weeks running (9/25, 10/2); the new 23-account repost push got the warmest reaction in weeks ('Amazing 😻'); Vivek finally gave a concrete cause on 10/3; Mayson chased Vivek about ten times and tried to force a three-way fix on 10/5 ('Lets get this sorted rn'); the login blocker closed; and the intake form was completed. The score still falls, for four reasons. (1) The churn pattern is forming. The 9/14 'isn’t sustainable' message is 25 days unanswered beyond a call offer. Invoice #5 was paid on 10/7 with zero questions, even though it bills a fortnight when her main was banned throughout. Under ALTR's pattern, clean, silent payment is a tell, not health. (2) Her asks are falling. There were 8 distinct client asks in the window: 6 in week one, then 2 in week two (the 10/5 @itsbarbxoxo plan and the Threads-appeal question). After 10/5 19:41 her only messages were payment and thank-yous ('hiii yes', 'i saw it', 'Sent :)', 'thank you 🫶🏼'). The w/e 9/25 report counted 6 newly opened questions, so the trend is about 6, then 6, then 2. The chat was completely silent for the last ~37 hours of the window. (3) Delivery has not moved on the core problem. Main banned 22 days with no date. The @barbarasilvanew handoff is unconfirmed 8 days after 'On it!'. Her 10/5 @itsbarbxoxo/Threads questions got 'I will check in lookup' and nothing more. The Threads root-cause check ('We will check', 9/22) is 17 days old. OFTV was dormant all of week two. (4) Billing outpaced service. Invoice #5 got two chasers (day 1 and day 6) and the pause-of-work clause a fourth time. Billing was one of only two threads that closed cleanly this window; the other was Melissa's broadcasts. Not 30s territory because she is still warm in tone, still cooperating, and service cadence (leak report, repost, tips) improved. Not 50s because the three signals above are textbook pre-exit.
